text:
maya: Heads up — the v3.2 pinned-route A/B is oscillating between variants. Saw automatic fallback kick in twice this morning.
jordan: where are you seeing the oscillation? metrics?
maya: p95 latency spikes on variant-B (quant4v3) + drop in concordance for longcode docs. MRR down 4.2% on test slice "long-code-snippets".
maya: ops-bot posted these incidents: "fallback triggered: variant-B -> variant-A (auto-fallback)" at 05:12, 06:03 
sam: did we change the fallback threshold? config looks like:
```yaml
fallback:
  delta_mrr: 0.03
  consecutive_windows: 2
  p95_latency: 800
route_pin:
  allow_partial_rollout: true
```
lee: yep changed last week to be more sensitive. That consecutive_windows=2 is too short for noisy slices.
jordan: propose: increase consecutive_windows to 4, delta_mrr to 0.05, and add cooldown 30m before re-allowing variant. Also add a ratio-based check so small-sample spikes don't flip. :eyes:
maya: sounds good. can we run a quick simulation on shadow logs before changing prod?
sam: i'll run a 24h replay against the long-code slice and post results in this thread.
deploy-bot: scheduled replay job id replay-20260322-01 queued by sam.
maya: thanks — if replay shows >1.5% uplift variance stable for 12h we can promote, else keep pinned to A and mute auto-fallback for this route for 48h.
jordan: ack. will update rollout config PR with proposed params and request a quick review from @lee. :thumbsup:
